jobs.title: Shipping Market Analyst
jobs.description:
Context & Environment: Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates Company: BxT Trading Contract Type: Local BxT is a joint venture between TotalEnergies and Bapco Energies, bringing together complementary market expertise, trading capabilities and regional presence. Based in Dubai and reporting to the Product Charterer, the Shipping Market Analyst will join BxT's shipping and trading activities, supporting commercial and strategic decision-making through high-quality analysis of oil shipping markets, tanker dynamics and freight economics. The role will work closely with the freight and trading desks, as well as BxT teams in Geneva, contributing to key internal tools, publications and market intelligence. This is a hands-on analytical position requiring a strong understanding of energy and shipping markets, the ability to turn complex and real-time data into actionable insights, and advanced Python capabilities to develop robust analytical tools. The successful candidate will operate with a high degree of autonomy in a fast-paced, trading-oriented environment. Activities:
• Understand the drivers of oil shipping and freight markets, including refining and trade flows.
• Collect and structure real-time data on tanker markets and freight rates.
• Develop ad-hoc indicators and decision-making tools to track market trends.
• Build scenario-based models to interpret signals from the oil and freight markets.
• Identify business needs and develop automated market intelligence tools.
• Provide timely insights to support trading strategies and market positioning.
• Produce regular and ad-hoc reports for the oil chartering team.
• Contribute to the development of U-TRACK, our proprietary Trading & Shipping tracking tool. Role Characteristics
• Autonomy: You will be responsible for your own analyses and their dissemination.
• Reactivity: You will operate in a time-sensitive environment where real-time information is critical.
• Collaboration: You will work closely with trading desks and analysts across regions.
• Impact: Your insights will shape trading decisions and strategic orientations. Candidate Profile:
• Master’s degree in economics, engineering, or energy.
• Strong understanding of energy markets, trading, and shipping.
• Ability to communicate complex topics clearly in English (Arabic is a plus).
• Strong proficiency in Python programming, with experience developing and maintaining analytical solutions involving tools and libraries such as Streamlit, Pandas, API integrations, and automation. Familiarity with Databricks is an advantage.
• Analytical mindset, rigor, autonomy, and initiative.
• Comfortable working under pressure and with tight deadlines.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Context & Environment: Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates Company: BxT Trading Contract Type: Local BxT è una joint venture tra TotalEnergies e Bapco Energies, che riunisce competenze di mercato complementari, capacità di trading e presenza regionale. Con sede a Dubai e segnalazione al Product Charterer, l'Analista del Mercato di Spedizioni si unirà alle attività di trasporto e di negoziazione di BxT, sostenendo il processo decisionale commerciale e strategico attraverso analisi di alta qualità dei mercati di trasporto del petrolio, della dinamica delle petroliere e dell'economia di trasporto. Il ruolo lavorerà a stretto contatto con gli uffici di trasporto e di negoziazione, così come i team BxT a Ginevra, contribuendo a strumenti interni chiave, pubblicazioni e intelligence di mercato. Si tratta di una posizione analitica pratica che richiede una forte comprensione dei mercati dell'energia e della spedizione, la capacità di trasformare i dati complessi e in tempo reale in insight attuabili, e capacità Python avanzate per sviluppare strumenti analitici robusti. Il candidato di successo opererà con un alto grado di autonomia in un ambiente veloce e orientato al trading. Attività:
• Comprendere i conducenti dei mercati petroliferi e delle merci, compresi i flussi di raffinazione e commercio.
• Raccogliere e strutturare i dati in tempo reale sui mercati delle petroliere e le tariffe di trasporto.
• Sviluppare indicatori ad-hoc e strumenti decisionali per monitorare le tendenze del mercato.
• Costruire modelli basati su scenari per interpretare i segnali dai mercati del petrolio e del trasporto.
• Identificare le esigenze aziendali e sviluppare strumenti informativi di mercato automatizzati.
• Fornire informazioni tempestive per sostenere le strategie di trading e il posizionamento del mercato.
• Produrre rapporti regolari e ad-hoc per il team di noleggio del petrolio.
• Contribuisci allo sviluppo di U-TRACK, il nostro proprietario Trading & Shipping Tracking tool. Caratteristiche del ruolo
• Autonomia: Sarai responsabile delle tue analisi e della loro diffusione.
• Reattività: Lei opererà in un ambiente sensibile al tempo in cui le informazioni in tempo reale sono critiche.
• Collaborazione: lavorerai a stretto contatto con banchi di trading e analisti in tutte le regioni.
• Impatto: Le tue intuizioni modellano le decisioni di trading e gli orientamenti strategici. Profilo del candidato:
• Laurea magistrale in economia, ingegneria o energia.
• Forte comprensione dei mercati dell'energia, del commercio e della spedizione.
• Capacità di comunicare argomenti complessi chiaramente in inglese (Arabic è un plus).
• Forte competenza nella programmazione Python, con lo sviluppo e il mantenimento di soluzioni analitiche che coinvolgono strumenti e librerie come Streamlit, Pandas, integrazioni API e automazione. La familiarità con Databricks è un vantaggio.
• Mindset analitico, rigore, autonomia e iniziativa.
• Confortevole lavoro sotto pressione e con scadenze strette.

jobs.title: Quantitative / Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Context & Environment: TotalEnergies is developing its activities across the power value chain, with a growing portfolio of renewable generation, flexible assets and power supply activities across Europe. Within Trading & Shipping, our algorithmic trading teams are building advanced quantitative and machine-learning solutions to support trading and optimization activities in European short-term power markets. As a Quantitative / Machine Learning Engineer , you will join a highly technical and collaborative environment at the intersection of energy trading, quantitative modelling, machine learning and software engineering . You will contribute directly to the development of models and algorithms used to identify and capture opportunities in European power markets, working closely with quantitative analysts, algorithmic traders, data scientists and IT specialists. The role offers significant exposure to fast-moving energy markets and the opportunity to work on models that move from research and back-testing through to live production and ultimately contribute to trading performance. Activities: As part of the Algorithmic Trading team, you will:
• Develop quantitative and machine-learning models supporting algorithmic trading strategies in European power markets.
• Build models across the full lifecycle, from data preparation and feature engineering through model training, optimization, validation and live deployment.
• Design new indicators, signals and features to improve quantitative and machine-learning trading models.
• Analyse large and complex datasets to identify patterns, relationships and trading signals.
• Conduct quantitative research on European power markets and translate market observations into actionable modelling ideas.
• Monitor the performance and robustness of models in both simulated and live trading environments.
• Continuously assess model behaviour and identify opportunities to improve forecasting accuracy and trading performance.
• Contribute to rigorous back-testing, validation and model-performance methodologies.
• Work with cross-functional teams to bring models into production and ensure their reliability, scalability and maintainability.
• Collaborate closely with algorithmic traders and technology teams to turn quantitative research into operational trading solutions.
• Contribute your data science expertise to broader modelling and optimization topics within the team. Candidate Profile: You have a strong quantitative background and enjoy applying advanced modelling techniques to complex, real-world problems. We are looking for someone with:
• An engineering degree, Master's degree or PhD in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Physics, Machine Learning, Computer Science or a related discipline .
• Approximately 2–3 years of professional experience working with machine-learning models in production , ideally involving live forecasting or other real-time applications.
• Strong proficiency in Python .
• Experience with MongoDB, SQL and Shell scripting .
• A solid understanding of software architecture and production-quality development practices.
• Experience with Docker and familiarity with DevOps/MLOps environments, including CI/CD pipelines .
• Strong knowledge of machine-learning techniques, including supervised and unsupervised learning.
• Practical experience with time-series modelling and analysis .
• The ability to analyse complex systems and identify direct and indirect relationships between multiple signals and datasets.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain quantitative results clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
• The ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative trading environment. Additional Assets The following would be considered an advantage:
• Previous exposure to energy, commodities or financial markets .
• Understanding of European power markets, power generation or energy supply mechanisms.
• Experience working with trading signals, forecasting models or optimization problems.
• Familiarity with project-management and collaborative tools such as Jira, Asana or Monday.com . Why Join Us? This role offers the opportunity to work at the forefront of data science and algorithmic trading within the energy sector . You will work on advanced quantitative models with a direct connection to live markets and trading decisions, while collaborating with experienced professionals across trading, quantitative research and technology. You will join an international environment where machine learning and quantitative analysis play an increasingly important role in optimizing TotalEnergies' activities across European power markets.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Context & Environment: TotalEnergies sta sviluppando le sue attività in tutta la filiera del valore energetico, con un portafoglio crescente di energie rinnovabili, risorse flessibili e attività di alimentazione in tutta Europa. All'interno di Trading & Shipping, i nostri team di trading algoritmico stanno costruendo soluzioni quantitative e machine-learning avanzate per supportare le attività di trading e ottimizzazione nei mercati europei di potenza a breve termine. Come Quantitativo / Machine Learning Engineer , si unirà a un ambiente altamente tecnico e collaborativo all'incrocio di trading energetico, modellazione quantitativa, machine learning e ingegneria software . Contribuirai direttamente allo sviluppo di modelli e algoritmi utilizzati per identificare e cogliere le opportunità nei mercati europei del potere, lavorando a stretto contatto con analisti quantitativi, operatori algoritmici, scienziati di dati e specialisti IT. Il ruolo offre un'esposizione significativa ai mercati energetici in rapida evoluzione e l'opportunità di lavorare su modelli che vanno dalla ricerca e dal back-test fino alla produzione dal vivo e, infine, contribuiscono alle prestazioni di trading. Attività: Hai un forte background quantitativo e goditi l'applicazione di tecniche di modellazione avanzate a problemi complessi e reali. Stiamo cercando qualcuno con:
• Un grado di ingegneria, laurea o dottorato in un campo quantitativo come matematica, fisica, machine learning, informatica o una disciplina correlata.
• Circa 2-3 anni di esperienza professionale che lavorano con modelli di machine-learning in produzione, idealmente coinvolgendo previsioni dal vivo o altre applicazioni in tempo reale.
• Forte competenza in Python .
• Esperienza con MongoDB, SQL and Shell scripting .
• Una solida comprensione dell'architettura del software e delle pratiche di sviluppo di qualità della produzione.
• Esperienza con Docker e familiarità con gli ambienti DevOps/MLOps, compresi quelli CI/CD .
• Forte conoscenza delle tecniche di apprendimento automatico, compreso l'apprendimento supervisionato e non supervisionato.
• Esperienza pratica con la modellazione e l'analisi delle serie temporali .
• La capacità di analizzare sistemi complessi e identificare relazioni dirette e indirette tra segnali multipli e dataset.
• Forte capacità di comunicazione e la capacità di spiegare chiaramente i risultati quantitativi sia agli stakeholder tecnici che di business.
• La capacità di lavorare efficacemente in un ambiente di trading veloce e collaborativo. Attività aggiuntive Di seguito sarebbe considerato un vantaggio:
• Precedente esposizione a energia, materie prime o mercati finanziari.
• Comprensione dei mercati europei del potere, della produzione di energia o dei meccanismi di approvvigionamento energetico.
• Esperienza di lavoro con segnali di trading, modelli di previsione o problemi di ottimizzazione.
• Familiarità con la gestione del progetto e strumenti collaborativi come Jira, Asana o Monday.com . Perché unirsi a noi? Questo ruolo offre l'opportunità di lavorare all'avanguardia della scienza dei dati e del trading algoritmico all'interno del settore energetico . Potrai lavorare su modelli quantitativi avanzati con una connessione diretta ai mercati dal vivo e alle decisioni di trading, collaborando con professionisti esperti attraverso il trading, la ricerca quantitativa e la tecnologia. Ti unirai a un ambiente internazionale in cui l'apprendimento automatico e l'analisi quantitativa svolgono un ruolo sempre più importante nell'ottimizzazione delle attività di TotalEnergies nei mercati europei del potere. Profilo del candidato: Come parte del team Algorithmic Trading, sarete:
• Sviluppa modelli quantitativi e machine-learning che supportano strategie di trading algoritmico nei mercati europei del potere.
• Costruire modelli in tutto il ciclo di vita, dalla preparazione dei dati e dall'ingegneria delle caratteristiche attraverso la formazione del modello, l'ottimizzazione, la validazione e la distribuzione dal vivo.
• Progettare nuovi indicatori, segnali e caratteristiche per migliorare i modelli di trading quantitativi e machine-learning.
• Analizzare grandi e complessi set di dati per identificare modelli, relazioni e segnali di trading.
• Condurre la ricerca quantitativa sui mercati europei del potere e tradurre le osservazioni di mercato in idee di modellazione attuabili.
• Monitorare le prestazioni e la robustezza dei modelli in ambienti di trading simulati e live.
• Valutare costantemente il comportamento del modello e identificare le opportunità per migliorare la precisione di previsione e le prestazioni di trading.
• Contribuisci a rigorosi metodi di back-testing, validazione e modellazione.
• Lavorare con team interfunzionali per portare i modelli in produzione e garantire la loro affidabilità, scalabilità e manutenbilità.
• Collabora a stretto contatto con i trader algoritmici e i team tecnologici per trasformare la ricerca quantitativa in soluzioni operative di trading.
• Contribuisci la tua esperienza di data science a temi di modellazione e ottimizzazione più ampi all'interno del team.

• Die Fähigkeit, effektiv in einer schnelllebigen, kollaborativen Handelsumgebung zu arbeiten. Zusätzliche Vermögenswerte Folgendes würde als Vorteil betrachtet:
• Frühere Exposition gegenüber Energie, Rohstoffen oder Finanzmärkten.
• Verständnis der europäischen Strommärkte, Stromerzeugungs- oder Energieversorgungsmechanismen.
• Erfahrung mit Handelssignalen, Prognosemodellen oder Optimierungsproblemen.
• Vertrautheit mit Projektmanagement und kollaborativen Tools wie Jira, Asana oder Monday.com. Warum mitmachen? Diese Rolle bietet die Möglichkeit, an der Spitze der Data Science und des algorithmischen Handels im Energiesektor zu arbeiten. Sie werden an fortgeschrittenen quantitativen Modellen mit einer direkten Verbindung zu Live-Markten und Handelsentscheidungen arbeiten, während Sie mit erfahrenen Fachleuten aus den Bereichen Handel, quantitative Forschung und Technologie zusammenarbeiten. Sie treten in ein internationales Umfeld ein, in dem maschinelles Lernen und quantitative Analyse eine immer wichtigere Rolle bei der Optimierung der Aktivitäten von TotalEnergies auf den europäischen Strommärkten spielen. Kandidatenprofil: Als Teil des Algorithmic Trading Teams werden Sie:
• Entwicklung quantitativer und maschineller Lernmodelle zur Unterstützung algorithmischer Handelsstrategien auf den europäischen Strommärkten.
• Erstellen Sie Modelle über den gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg, von der Datenaufbereitung und Feature Engineering bis hin zu Modellschulungen, Optimierung, Validierung und Live-Bereitstellung.
• Entwerfen Sie neue Indikatoren, Signale und Funktionen, um quantitative und maschinelle Lernmodelle zu verbessern.
• Analysieren Sie große und komplexe Datensätze, um Muster, Beziehungen und Handelssignale zu identifizieren.
• Durchführung quantitativer Untersuchungen zu den europäischen Strommärkten und Umsetzung von Marktbeobachtungen in umsetzbare Modellierungsideen.
• Überwachen Sie die Leistung und Robustheit von Modellen in simulierten und Live-Handelsumgebungen.
• Bewerten Sie kontinuierlich das Modellverhalten und identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten, die Prognosegenauigkeit und die Handelsleistung zu verbessern.
• Beitrag zu strengen Backtesting-, Validierungs- und Modellleistungsmethoden.
• Arbeiten Sie mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um Modelle in Produktion zu bringen und deren Zuverlässigkeit, Skalierbarkeit und Wartbarkeit sicherzustellen.
• Arbeiten Sie eng mit algorithmischen Händlern und Technologieteams zusammen, um quantitatives Research in operative Handelslösungen umzuwandeln.
• Bringen Sie Ihre Data-Science-Expertise in breitere Modellierungs- und Optimierungsthemen im Team ein.

En tant qu'ingénieur quantitative / Machine Learning , vous rejoindrez un environnement hautement technique et collaboratif à l'intersection du commerce de l'énergie, de la modélisation quantitative, de la machine Learning et de l'ingénierie logicielle . Vous contribuerez directement au développement de modèles et d'algorithmes utilisés pour identifier et saisir des opportunités sur les marchés européens de l'électricité, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec des analystes quantitatifs, des négociants algorithmiques, des data savants et des spécialistes de l'informatique. • La capacité d'analyser des systèmes complexes et d'identifier les relations directes et indirectes entre plusieurs signaux et ensembles de données.
• De solides compétences en communication et la capacité d'expliquer clairement les résultats quantitatifs aux intervenants techniques et commerciaux.
• La capacité de travailler efficacement dans un environnement commercial coopératif et rapide. Actifs supplémentaires Les éléments suivants seraient considérés comme un avantage:
• Exposition antérieure à l'énergie, aux matières premières ou aux marchés financiers .
• Compréhension des marchés européens de l'électricité, de la production d'électricité ou des mécanismes d'approvisionnement énergétique.
• Expérience de travail avec des signaux de trading, des modèles de prévision ou des problèmes d'optimisation.

Vous travaillerez sur des modèles quantitatifs avancés avec un lien direct avec les marchés en direct et les décisions commerciales, tout en collaborant avec des professionnels expérimentés à travers le commerce, la recherche quantitative et la technologie. • Développer des modèles quantitatifs et d'apprentissage automatique soutenant des stratégies de trading algorithmique sur les marchés européens de l'électricité.
• Construisez des modèles tout au long du cycle de vie, depuis la préparation des données et l'ingénierie des fonctionnalités jusqu'à la formation, l'optimisation, la validation et le déploiement en direct.
• Concevoir de nouveaux indicateurs, signaux et caractéristiques pour améliorer les modèles de négociation quantitatifs et d'apprentissage automatique.
• Analyser les ensembles de données importants et complexes afin d'identifier les modèles, les relations et les signaux commerciaux.
• Mener des recherches quantitatives sur les marchés européens de l'électricité et traduire les observations de marché en idées de modélisation réalisables.
• Surveiller les performances et la robustesse des modèles dans les environnements de négociation simulés et en direct.
• Évaluer continuellement le comportement du modèle et déterminer les possibilités d'améliorer l'exactitude des prévisions et la performance des échanges.
• Contribuer à des méthodes rigoureuses de contre-essais, de validation et de performance des modèles.
• Travailler avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour mettre les modèles en production et assurer leur fiabilité, leur évolutivité et leur maintenance.
• Collaborer étroitement avec les traders algorithmiques et les équipes technologiques pour transformer la recherche quantitative en solutions opérationnelles de trading.
• Contribuez votre expertise en sciences des données à des sujets de modélisation et d'optimisation plus vastes au sein de l'équipe.

jobs.title: Tech Lead – Advanced Analytics
jobs.description:
Context & Environment: The Advanced Analytics team is part of the Power & Gas Trading IT department and develops software products that enable advanced quantitative analytics across European and Worldwide energy markets. Our mission is to build scalable, production-grade applications supporting Traders, Quantitative Analysts and Market Analysts in forecasting, optimization, simulation and data analysis. Working closely with quantitative teams, we transform analytical and machine learning models into robust software products capable of operating reliably in production while remaining flexible for future evolution. As a Tech Lead , you will provide technical leadership across the Advanced Analytics product landscape. You will combine hands-on software engineering with architectural thinking, guiding technical decisions, promoting engineering excellence, and partnering with quantitative stakeholders to deliver high-quality analytics platforms. This is not a people management role . Success in this position comes from technical expertise, influence, mentoring and the ability to drive engineering best practices across multiple initiatives. Activities: As a Tech Lead, your main responsibilities will be to:
• Lead the technical design and implementation of software products supporting forecasting, optimization, simulation and advanced analytics use cases.
• Drive software architecture and technical decisions in collaboration with Solution Architects, ensuring consistency, scalability, security and maintainability across the Advanced Analytics landscape.
• Partner closely with Quantitative Analysts, Traders and business stakeholders to understand, challenge and refine functional and technical requirements.
• Translate quantitative research into reliable, production-ready software solutions while ensuring long-term maintainability and extensibility.
• Design cloud-native applications following modern engineering principles and best practices for reliability, observability, security and cost optimization.
• Lead the industrialization of analytical and machine learning models, ensuring reproducibility, scalability, monitoring and operational excellence.
• Contribute to software development, code reviews, technical investigations and complex implementations.
• Promote engineering excellence through coding standards, automated testing, CI/CD, documentation and continuous improvement.
• Mentor and support engineers through technical coaching, architectural guidance and knowledge sharing, without direct line management responsibilities.
• Support production systems, troubleshoot complex technical issues and drive continuous improvement of existing applications. In addition, the Tech Lead will be expected to:
• Own technical decisions from solution design through production delivery.
• Establish and promote engineering standards across the Advanced Analytics team.
• Balance short-term delivery objectives with long-term architectural sustainability.
• Make sound technical decisions in environments with evolving requirements and incomplete information.
• Identify technical risks early and propose pragmatic, scalable solutions.
• Drive adoption of modern software engineering practices and emerging technologies where they provide tangible business value.
• Build credibility with both software engineers and quantitative experts by combining strong engineering capabilities with an understanding of analytical modelling challenges.
• Influence technical direction through collaboration, expertise and leadership rather than formal authority. Candidate Profile: Education
• Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering or related technical discipline. Experience
• Minimum 6 years of professional experience in software development, data science or related fields, including experience acting as a technical lead or senior technical contributor on complex software products.
• Experience deploying, operating and maintaining analytical or machine learning solutions in production environments.
• Experience working in Agile product teams within complex enterprise environments.
• Experience working in the energy trading industry, particularly in power markets, would be considered an advantage. Technical Skills
• Expert-level proficiency in Python and experience building production-grade backend applications.
• Strong experience designing cloud-native applications and distributed systems on AWS.
• Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, API design and system integration.
• Experience designing RESTful APIs and event-driven architectures.
• Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and orchestration platforms including Kubernetes and ECS.
• Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code.
• Solid understanding of relational databases, SQL, data modelling and modern data platform architectures.
• Hands-on experience with Databricks, MLflow or comparable modern data and MLOps platforms.
• Strong knowledge of software engineering best practices, including automated testing, code reviews, observability and production support.
• Familiarity with Lakehouse architectures and modern Data Engineering practices would be an asset.
• Experience developing modern frontend applications and data visualization tools using React, or similar frameworks, would be considered a plus. Skills
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to interact effectively with both technical and quantitative audiences.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
• Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and provide technical leadership through influence.
• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative and international environment.
• Strong commitment to engineering excellence and continuous improvement. Additional Information Preferred qualifications include:
• PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Operations Research, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence or another quantitative discipline.
• Understanding of European energy systems, electricity markets and quantitative trading workflows.
• Experience with forecasting, optimization, time-series analysis or other quantitative modelling techniques, together with an understanding of the challenges involved in bringing analytical models into production.
• Experience building data-intensive or AI-enabled platforms supporting quantitative research.
• Knowledge of MLOps best practices, including model lifecycle management, model versioning, reproducibility, monitoring and governance.
• Experience leveraging AI-assisted software development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent) to improve engineering productivity while maintaining high standards of software quality.

jobs.description:
Context & Environment: TotalEnergies has developed strong expertise across oil and biofuels, natural gas, electricity and low-carbon energies. Our trading activities are conducted from our main international hubs, including Geneva, Paris, Houston and Singapore. TotalEnergies Gas & Power (TGP) is the trading arm of TotalEnergies for gas, LNG, power and low-carbon energies. Operating in highly dynamic and volatile markets, TGP plays a key role in supporting the Group's ambitions through the optimisation and management of complex energy portfolios. Based within our Gas, Power & Emissions (GPE) Operations team, you will support the management of TotalEnergies' physical gas and power portfolios across Europe. The team operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, ensuring the safe and efficient management of physical positions across European pipeline and transmission networks. The position is therefore organised on a shift basis, including nights, weekends and public holidays. Working in a fast-paced trading environment, you will interact closely with Gas, Power and LNG Trading Desks, Group affiliates, upstream and downstream teams, network operators and external counterparties. Activities: As a GPE Shift Operator, you will directly support the Gas and Power Trading Desks and contribute to the operational and commercial management of the Group's physical portfolio. Your main responsibilities will include:
• Manage physical gas and power positions across UK and Continental European markets.
• Maintain continuous communication with Gas, Power and LNG Trading Desks, Group affiliates, offshore field operators, procurement teams and external counterparties.
• Accurately and promptly nominate physical positions to transporters, transmission system operators and other relevant market participants using dedicated systems.
• Monitor operational data flows together with intraday and day-ahead market movements.
• Manage and balance the portfolio by responding to changes in supply and demand and instructions from the relevant trading and procurement desks.
• Commercially optimise physical positions outside standard office hours, including through electronic energy exchanges and OTC transactions, under the direction of the relevant Trading Desks.
• Manage upstream gas portfolios and portfolios for entities for which TotalEnergies acts as shipping agent, including the preparation of balancing reports.
• Ensure that entry and exit capacity requirements are appropriately managed.
• Liaise with counterparties regarding retrospective physical gas transactions where required.
• Review allocation data against nominated quantities, identify discrepancies and coordinate their resolution.
• Contribute proactively to business developments and identify opportunities to improve operational and commercial performance.
• Ensure that all activities comply with applicable pipeline and grid operator rules, market regulations, industry codes and internal procedures.
• Contribute to minimising financial penalties and operational exposure across the markets in which the team operates. You will operate across major UK and European trading hubs, interconnectors, storage facilities, LNG terminals, offshore fields, power plants and refineries. The role provides significant exposure to energy trading activities and acts as a key interface between Trading, Operations, Procurement, Back Office, Finance and Legal teams. Candidate Profile:
• You hold a university degree, ideally in Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, Science or another relevant quantitative discipline.
• You have at least 1 year of relevant industry experience, ideally within gas and/or power operations, energy trading, scheduling, dispatching or a comparable position.
• You have strong numerical and analytical skills and are comfortable working with large volumes of data.
• You are fluent in English. Additional European languages would be an advantage.
• You are resilient and able to make accurate decisions quickly and confidently in a fast-moving environment.
• You are flexible and comfortable working within a 24/7 shift organisation, including nights, weekends and public holidays.
• You enjoy working collaboratively and communicating with a broad range of internal and external stakeholders.
• You demonstrate strong attention to detail together with sound commercial judgement.
• You have strong interpersonal and communication skills.
• You are proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. At TotalEnergies, we believe that our employees' fulfilment comes from the diversity of experiences and opportunities available to them. We are committed to diversity and inclusion and to providing equal employment opportunities to all candidates.

• Sei fluente in inglese. Altre lingue europee sarebbero un vantaggio.

• Ti piace lavorare in collaborazione e comunicare con una vasta gamma di stakeholder interni ed esterni.

• Sei esperto in Microsoft Office, in particolare Excel. In TotalEnergies, crediamo che la soddisfazione dei nostri dipendenti derivi dalla diversità di esperienze e opportunità a loro disposizione. Siamo impegnati nella diversità e nell'inclusione e nel fornire pari opportunità di lavoro a tutti i candidati.

Nos activités commerciales sont menées à partir de nos principaux centres internationaux, dont Genève, Paris, Houston et Singapour. TotalEnergies Gas & Power (TGP) est le bras de négociation de TotalEnergies pour le gaz, le GNL, l'énergie et les énergies à faible intensité de carbone. Opérant sur des marchés très dynamiques et volatils, TGP joue un rôle clé pour soutenir les ambitions du Groupe par l'optimisation et la gestion de portefeuilles énergétiques complexes. Basé sur notre équipe d'exploitation Gaz, Puissance et Émissions (GPE), vous soutiendrez la gestion des portefeuilles de gaz et d'énergie physiques de TotalEnergies dans toute l'Europe. L'équipe fonctionne 24 heures sur 24, 7 jours sur 7, assurant une gestion sûre et efficace des positions physiques sur les réseaux européens de pipeline et de transport. La position est donc organisée par équipe, y compris les nuits, les week-ends et les jours fériés. Travaillant dans un environnement de trading rapide, vous interagirez étroitement avec les bureaux de trading du gaz, de l'électricité et du GNL, les filiales du Groupe, les équipes en amont et en aval, les opérateurs de réseau et les contreparties externes. Activités : En tant qu'opérateur de poste GPE, vous soutiendrez directement les comptoirs de commerce du gaz et de l'électricité et contribuerez à la gestion opérationnelle et commerciale du portefeuille physique du Groupe. jobs.title: Derivatives & Market Risk Analyst Intern
jobs.description:
Context & Environment: Take your first steps into energy trading Interested in derivatives, quantitative finance and global energy markets? Discover how trading portfolios are valued, monitored and analysed every day. About Us TotalEnergies is an integrated multi-energy company with expertise in oil and biofuels, natural gas, electricity and low-carbon energies. Our Trading & Shipping and Gas & Power activities connect international energy markets with trading teams and support functions. Our Geneva hub brings together specialists working across physical and financial energy markets. Our Culture Energy markets move quickly, and so do our teams. We value curiosity, analytical thinking, collaboration and initiative. As an intern, you will learn from experienced professionals, contribute to real projects and work in a diverse, international environment where continuous development and respect are central to how we work. Activities: Within TotalEnergies Trading & Shipping in Geneva, the Derivatives Middle Office team monitors the performance and market risks of trading portfolios. Working at the interface of Front Office, Finance and risk-control functions, the team analyses positions, valuations and market movements to provide accurate daily reporting and reliable indicators for decision-making. This internship offers hands-on exposure to derivatives, commodity markets and quantitative risk analysis in a fast-moving international trading environment. Your Responsibilities
• Support daily monitoring of trading positions, portfolio exposures and risk indicators, including Value at Risk (VaR), stress tests and sensitivity analysis.
• Assist with the calculation, control and explanation of daily profit and loss (PnL), including analysis of market movements and other key drivers.
• Help verify the consistency of transaction data, pricing inputs, market curves and mark-to-market valuations against available information.
• Contribute to quantitative analysis and the development, testing and improvement of risk monitoring and reporting tools, working with Middle Office, traders and IT teams.
• Prepare clear analyses and documentation to communicate findings to the team and support reliable reporting. Candidate Profile:
• Currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Quantitative Finance, Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Engineering or another strongly quantitative field.
• Strong mathematical and analytical skills, with an interest in derivatives pricing, financial modelling and stochastic processes.
• Strong Python programming skills and proficiency in Excel; knowledge of SQL and VBA is an advantage.
• Understanding of financial derivatives, such as futures, swaps and options; an interest in commodity and energy markets is valued.
• Rigorous, curious and proactive, with the ability to analyse complex information, communicate clearly and work collaboratively under deadlines.
• Fluent English; French is an advantage.
• A tri-partite agreement is mandatory

• Monitor availability of new data sources and tools to expand the current reach of the team’s analytics.
• Extracts meaningful insights from European fundamental models and fundamental data in collaboration with other analysts (generation, demand, flows, weather impact, etc) and contribute to the market watch on market structure in terms of companies, infrastructure and regulations.

• Lead discussions with trading desks and/or senior management.

• Conduct ad hoc analysis and projects in support of other analysts, traders, and senior management. Candidate Profile: Start date: 01/10/2026
• Ongoing studies in Economics, Business or Engineering.
• Knowledge of the European power and emissions market, power systems dispatch and flows dynamics and/or understanding of operations.
• Excellent skills with the Microsoft Office suite (Power Point, Excel…).
• Skilly in Python programming and Databricks are welcome.
• Good analytical skills, ability to transform large amounts of information into a few key insights.
• Working experience within a trading environment is welcome;
• Familiarity with visualization frameworks (PowerBI/etc.) are welcome.
• Fluent in English (oral and written) – knowledge of French and/or other languages is an advantage

• The ideal candidate should be able to explain complex issues and present them in a clear and concise manner. Accountabilities
• Provide in-depth analysis to identify current and future drivers and behaviours of the European power and emissions markets.
• Provide a proactive advisory view of the European power and emissions market to the relevant desks and to the management

• Promote TGP trading activities to market partners and counterparts via reports, meetings and intervention at external meetings and conferences
